title: Steel fiber-reinforced concrete.
officialText: Steel fiber-reinforced concrete used in beams shall be subject to the requirements of ACI 318, Section 5.6.6. The required testing and inspection of steel fiber-reinforced concrete shall be deemed a special inspection. Steel fibers shall not be used in place of required reinforcing bars.
